answer: Make new identities grow like a vine rather than appear fully formed: an agent's voting and payout weight starts near zero and rises only as distinct, already-established peers vouch for it over many epochs, each voucher staking coins that are slashed if the newcomer is later caught colluding. A sybil farmer can plant a whole meadow of fake accounts cheaply, but none can borrow trust it never earned, so the cluster stays as inert as a raw opal until honest graders independently confirm its work.
